channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Eleitores de direita e de esquerda concordam sobre Estado forte na economia
item.description: A digital survey by Ipsos shows that anti-Lula and anti-Bolsonaro voters agree on the need for a strong state in the economy, explaining why a liberal third way finds no space in Brazil. José Roberto de Toledo discusses this convergence on the A Hora program on Canal UOL.

item.title: O que preocupa o Planalto nessa estadia prolongada de Lulinha na Espanha
item.description: Leaked documents and messages suggest that Fábio Lula, the president's son, may lead an influence lobby within the government, linked to an external lobbyist and politicians tied to the 'petrolão' scandal. Despite investigations, he continues a leisurely life in Spain, worrying the Planalto leadership due to reputational risks for Lula.

item.title: Nikolas Ferreira já arrecadou R$ 53,9 mil em vaquinha para a campanha
item.description: Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) declared to the TSE R$53,900 raised through online crowdfunding with 2,046 donations. His assets grew 10,488% in four years, rising from R$36,000 to R$3.8 million, including investments of R$2 million and a property valued at R$2.2 million with a debt of R$1.7 million.

item.title: Moro recebeu R$ 200 mil em doações de sócios em empresa de energia
item.description: Sergio Moro (PL) received R$200,000 in donations from partners of Rejaile Group, an energy company, as declared to the TSE. Jefferson and Mauricio Abou Rejaile each donated R$100,000, while Anna Carolina Nabhan and Fariz Mitri Nabhan contributed R$20,000 and R$5,000, respectively. Donations comply with electoral rules limiting individual contributions and requiring financial transparency.

item.title: Eduardo reposta críticas a Michelle: “Triste, mas verdadeiro”
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro (PL-SP) resumed criticism of his sister Michelle Bolsonaro, agreeing with influencer Allan dos Santos on distrust in her political trajectory. He reiterated preference for Bia Kicis and Sebastião Coelho over Michelle in the DF race, maintaining stance against the leading candidate. The position comes amid recent reconciliation between the Bolsonaro siblings.

item.title: Sem citar Lula, Flávio faz discurso curto em Barretos com aceno para o Agro sem apresentar proposta para o setor
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro spoke at the Peão de Barretos festival, emphasizing agribusiness without presenting specific sector proposals. He avoided mentioning Lula, but part of the audience cursed the socialist leader. The candidate reaffirmed support for farming and his father, Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Dino determina nulidade de emendas decididas por dirigentes partidários e ex-parlamentares
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino ordered the nullity of parliamentary amendments decided by party leaders or former lawmakers, following an investigation launched after statements by PL leader Valdemar da Costa Neto. Dino emphasized that such allocations are unconstitutional and requested statements from all parties represented in Congress. Most parties denied the existence of mechanisms for allocating amendments by leadership, and documents will be sent to the Federal Police for analysis.

item.title: As estatísticas na área de segurança pública que podem favorecer a campanha de Tarcísio
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas leads 2026 polling at 50%, benefiting from positive public security statistics, including declining rates of intentional violent deaths. His campaign highlights the creation of an Intelligence and Innovation Center and joint operations with the city government, though Haddad criticizes the transparency of these figures.

item.title: Brilha uma estrelinha
item.description: Brazilian media spent months scrutinizing the relationship between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and former banker Daniel Vorcaro over the film Dark Horse, which raised suspicions due to its secret millionaire sponsorship. The case damaged Flávio Bolsonaro’s image, with no explanations about the funding’s origin.

item.title: Apenas 12 dos 54 ex-ministros do governo Bolsonaro estarão nas urnas em outubro
item.description: Out of 54 former Bolsonaro ministers, only 12 (22%) will run in October's elections for state, Senate, gubernatorial, and Chamber positions. Half seek reelection, while others finish their terms or face imprisonment related to the coup plot.

item.title: Elche x Barcelona na La Liga: onde assistir, horário e escalações
item.description: Elche hosts Barcelona this Sunday at 16:30 Brasília time at the Martínez Valero Stadium in the second round of LaLiga 2026/27, broadcast exclusively by CazéTV. Barcelona, the reigning champion, begins defending its title after major squad changes, while Elche aims to leverage home support.

item.title: País que mais importa calçados do Brasil são os Estados Unidos
item.description: In July 2026, the U.S. was the largest importer of Brazilian footwear, purchasing $15.8 million worth, while Brazil imported $30.5 million in shoes, mostly from Vietnam. The footwear industry faces external pressures, such as the 37.5% tariff imposed by Trump, and domestic challenges, with Lula's new decree eliminating import taxes, threatening 53,900 jobs.

item.title: Vietnã é país de onde mais vêm calçados importados pelo Brasil
item.description: Vietnam leads Brazilian footwear imports, while the US is the main destination for Brazilian footwear exports. The industry faces threats on both export and import fronts, with US tariffs and the removal of import taxes jeopardizing 53,900 jobs.

item.title: Defesa de Lulinha tem estratégia de Marco Aurélio e banca exclusiva em Madri
item.description: Marco Aurélio de Carvalho coordinates Lulinha's defense in the influence trafficking investigations, serving as intermediary between Lula and Roberta Luchsinger. While pressuring against leaks and questioning the alleged 'Lava Jato wing' of the PF in Brazil, a team of seven lawyers in Madrid prepares the international defense. There are concerns about potential police actions against Lula's son.

item.title: Pesquisas eleitorais mostram a distância entre Lula e Flávio após números da semana
item.description: Recent polls show Lula leading Flávio in a hypothetical runoff, but within the margin of error, suggesting a technical tie. The gap between the two candidates ranges from three to four percentage points across institutes, maintaining stability in voting intentions. In the first round, Lula also leads numerically with an advantage over the runner-up.

item.title: Ana Castela faz o ‘V’ de vitória com Nikolas
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) shared a photo with singer Ana Castela at the Festa do Peão de Barretos, an event used as a stage for senator Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) presidential campaign. The meeting reinforces alliances and visibility for PL figures in Minas Gerais during the pre-campaign period.

item.title: Palmeiras x Vasco no Brasileirão: onde assistir, horário e escalações
item.description: Palmeiras and Vasco face off this Sunday, the 23rd, at 4 p.m., at Nubank Parque, in the 24th round of the Brazilian Championship. The match will be broadcast live by TV Globoost and Premiere. Palmeiras aims to strengthen its campaign after securing a spot in the Copa Libertadores quarterfinals.

item.title: A PF e o motivo da reaproximação de Davi Alcolumbre e Lula, segundo um aliado do petista
item.description: A close associate of Lula claims that Davi Alcolumbre's rapprochement with the president stems from convergences on security issues and foreign relations, aiming to consolidate alliances ahead of the 2026 electoral cycle.

item.title: MPE não vê irregularidade em foto de Lula com chapéu
item.description: The Electoral Public Ministry determined that Lula's photo wearing a hat in his candidacy application has no irregularity, stating the accessory does not constitute election propaganda nor hinder candidate recognition. The body argued that allowing the hat supports political pluralism, a key principle of the Democratic Rule of Law.

item.title: O filho do pai e o pai do filho (por Mary Zaidan)
item.description: The article examines investigations involving children of famous politicians, highlighting differences in media and judicial treatment. It questions the impartiality of accusations during election periods and suggests intentional misinformation to sway public opinion.

item.title: Os dois chapéus de Sidônio, na Secom e na campanha de Lula
item.description: Sidônio Palmeira, head of the Secretariat for Communication, works both in government management and directly in Lula's campaign, while his former partner Raul Rabelo took over as campaign strategist. The article highlights the overlap of roles and Sidônio's parallel activities outside the Planalto Palace.

item.title: Ministério Público Eleitoral não vê irregularidade na foto de Lula com chapéu na urna
item.description: The Electoral Public Prosecutor's Office stated to the TSE that there is no irregularity in President Lula's photo wearing a hat on the electronic ballot, authorizing the accessory due to medical recommendation. The decision supports political pluralism, according to Deputy Attorney General Alexandre Espinosa, and shows no electoral propaganda connotation.

item.title: Ana Castela aparece com Nikolas e faz gesto ligado ao PL
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) posted on Instagram a photo with singer Ana Castela during the Barretos Bull Riding Festival, making the number 22, associated with the PL party's slogan. The post received mixed reactions, with both support and criticism for the singer. The event featured right-wing politicians such as Flávio Bolsonaro and Tarcísio de Freitas.

item.title: Tarcísio reforça apoio a Flávio: “É o herdeiro do projeto de Bolsonaro”
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas reinforced his support for Flávio Bolsonaro at the Barretos Rodeo Festival, stating he is the heir to Jair Bolsonaro's political project. The governor emphasized that Bolsonaro chose Flávio to run for president, reaffirming an alliance between Republicans and PL. This statement was made during a public event in São Paulo state.

item.title: A 'mudança de pele' que tornou o escândalo do INSS mais explosivo para Lula
item.description: The INSS scandal lost traction after being rebranded as the 'Lulinha scandal,' amplifying its political weight and electoral risks for Lula ahead of 2026.

item.title: Em Barretos, Tarcísio diz que Flávio é herdeiro do projeto de Bolsonaro
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas stated in Barretos that Flávio Bolsonaro is Jair Bolsonaro's successor and supports his 2026 presidential bid. He emphasized São Paulo's strategic role in the election, expressing optimism about the results. The race remains technically tied according to recent polls.

item.title: Viana acusa Alcolumbre de “omissão” e cobra reação a Lula e Moraes
item.description: Senator Carlos Viana (PSD-MG) accused Senate President Davi Alcolumbre of omission during a campaign event in Belo Horizonte, demanding a reaction to Supreme Court decisions and figures like Lula and Moraes. He advocated for the balance of powers and criticized Alcolumbre's leadership.

item.title: Os dois negócios que Lulinha e lobista tinham com o Careca do INSS
item.description: Messages seized by the Federal Police reveal that Antônio Carlos Camilo Antunes, known as Careca do INSS, maintained two side businesses with lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger and President Lula's son, involving cannabidiol-based medications and rapid dengue tests at the Ministry of Health. The group was investigated for influence peddling and INSS fraud, with potential revenue of R$1 billion through government contracts.

item.title: Indefinições e reviravoltas marcam a reta final da pré-campanha em Alagoas
item.description: The final stretch of the pre-campaign in Alagoas was marked by uncertainty and strategic moves, including the Senate race between Arthur Lira and Renan Calheiros, Alfredo Gaspar's withdrawal, and JHC's indecision about which office to run for. Despite leading polls, JHC only officially declared his gubernatorial bid on the last day, after complex negotiations and political pressures. The scenario reflects an intense internal dispute among local and national elites.

item.title: Estados decisivos podem encerrar eleição no 1º turno e impor desafios a Lula e Flávio
item.description: Six weeks before the 2026 elections, key state races in São Paulo, Rio, and the Northeast may conclude in the first round. This forces Lula and Flávio to mobilize voters without state campaign rallies, complicating voter engagement. With 57% of voters potentially reaching a second round, the electoral dynamics become more challenging.

item.title: Rejeição empata no Datafolha e expõe voto cristalizado de Lula e Flávio
item.description: New Datafolha poll shows tied rejection rates between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, indicating stable voter intentions. Voters are already crystallized with few undecideds or swing movements. The discussion analyzed events that may influence the electoral scenario.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio quer abordar Nordeste como "novo Vale do Silício”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign aims to portray Northeast Brazil as a new tech and energy hub, emphasizing potential in oil, gas, renewables, and rare earth minerals to attract data centers and boost AI. The candidate plans to use the traditionally left-leaning region to promote local development and public security, with running mate Alfredo Gaspar as the main reference on the issue.

item.title: Campanha de Lula descarta programa temático sobre evangélicos na TV por temor de soar ‘fake’
item.description: Lula's campaign discards a thematic program about evangelicals on TV due to fear of sounding 'fake', opting for a more subtle approach. Nevertheless, there were explicit nods to religious voters during the launch, and First Lady Janja sang gospel jingles. The PT struggles to win over evangelical voters, with only 24% support against Flávio Bolsonaro's 43%.

item.title: Janja volta ao palco e canta em ato de Lula no Rio
item.description: First Lady Janja da Silva performed the 'Tapete Vermelho' jingle alongside pastor and gospel singer Kleber Lucas during Lula's campaign rally at the Moça Bonita Stadium in Bangu, western Rio de Janeiro. The event served as a show of support for the PT candidate's reelection, gathering supporters in the city's west zone.

item.title: Em Barretos, Flávio exalta agro e diz que voltará à Festa do Peão com Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro attended the Festa do Peão in Barretos, advocating for agribusiness and announcing his return in 2027 as president, accompanied by Jair Bolsonaro. The event featured Governor Tarcísio de Freitas and emphasized the primary sector's role in the economy.

item.title: Isabela Kalil: Desembarque do Centrão muda o lugar dos Bolsonaro na direita
item.description: Anthropologist Isabela Kalil assesses that the center-right's distancing from Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) candidacy signals a shift in the Brazilian right-wing, highlighting the failure of trying to use bolsonarism without submitting to it. She argues that the Bolsonaro family has hegemonized the political field while allies gave up containing it, and the 2026 election marks a new turning point, with Flávio running for president weakened by Jair Bolsonaro's imprisonment.

item.title: Frase do dia
item.description: Lula states that, coming from extreme poverty and lacking educational opportunities, he became president three times, describing it as a miracle. He suggests his profile reflects Brazilian reality and society.

item.title: Sem Lula nem Flávio, primeiro debate das eleições tem esvaziamento inédito
item.description: The first presidential debate of the 2026 election cycle takes place without Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, marking an unprecedented emptiness with only low-polling candidates participating. The absence of PT and PL leaders is strategic to avoid concentrated criticism, while Bandeirantes keeps empty podiums to highlight their decision.

item.title: Esnobado por Lula e Flávio, debate tem grande interesse do eleitor, mostra pesquisa
item.description: The first presidential debate on Band, at 8 PM on the 23rd, will take place without Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, despite 86% of voters planning to watch. Their absence contradicts voter interest, particularly among the undecided.

item.title: Coreógrafo vira maior doador do partido de Renan Santos em 2026
item.description: Choreographer Alberto Broner Worcman, known as 'Gingi', is the largest donor to the Missão party that nominated Renan Santos for the 2026 presidential race, contributing BRL 152,000 between February and April. The party declared BRL 1.8 million in donations, including BRL 1.2 million from collective funding.

item.title: Sem Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro, os debates ainda importam? O que dizem os especialistas
item.description: The first presidential debate of 2026 will take place without the presence of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Flávio Bolsonaro, the frontrunners in the polls. Lula stated he will not participate in debates where 'nonsense is spoken', while Flávio said he will only attend if Lula is present. Both are expected to participate only in the final debate, organized by TV Globo on October 1st.

item.title: Lula tem 22 dos seus 30 ex-ministros como candidatos em 12 estados em 2026
item.description: Lula has 30 former ministers in his third term, 22 (73%) of whom will run for office in 12 states during the 2026 elections. Notably, Vice President Geraldo Alckmin and several former cabinet heads are joining Lula's ticket. This lineup reflects strong coalition-building and organized parallel support for re-election.

item.title: Jantar na casa de Moraes com Lula e Alcolumbre teria tratado de como fragilizar Mendonça
item.description: Reports suggest a dinner involving Lula, Alcolumbre, and Moraes at the STF minister's house included discussions targeting Minister André Mendonça, who serves as rapporteur in high-profile cases. The information reached Mendonça's office, fueling speculation. The story is behind a paywall with limited public details.

item.title: Sem Lula e Flávio, debate na Band terá Caiado, Zema, Renan e Cury
item.description: The Band presidential debate, scheduled for Sunday (August 23, 2026), will feature Ronaldo Caiado, Romeu Zema, Renan Santos, and Augusto Cury, while Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro will not participate. The format keeps empty podiums symbolically for the absent candidates, with topics including public security, the economy, and mental health, as all contenders advocate for public spending cuts.

item.title: Planalto pressiona, mas senadores admitem votação da 6x1 após eleição
item.description: Despite pressure from the Presidency, senators admit that the vote on the PEC ending the 6x1 work scale may be postponed until after the October elections due to lack of time for processing. The matter remains in the Senate's CCJ and will only be discussed on September 3rd, while Senate President Davi Alcolumbre maintains control over the text's progress.

item.title: Sua vida, como vai?
item.description: A poll of 765 readers reveals that 78.8% believe their lives have improved over the past four years, while 21.2% say they have worsened. The content includes political and cultural commentary such as electoral analysis, racial self-declaration trends, and a satirical cartoon featuring Lulinha and Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Urnas eletrônicas são testadas em eleição simulada no Maranhão
item.description: A simulated election will take place in Paulino Neves, Maranhão, to test the electronic voting booth systems and processes before the official elections in October 2026. Led by the TSE and TRE-MA since 2004, the initiative involves 15,000 voters and 96 poll workers, evaluating the security, agility, and infrastructure of the electronic voting system.

item.title: 438 deputados federais tentam reeleição
item.description: 438 of the 513 federal deputies submitted to the TSE are running for re-election to the Chamber of Deputies in October. The PL (77) and PT (57) lead the ranking of parties with the most candidates seeking re-election, followed by União Brasil (49).

item.title: 438 deputados federais tentam a reeleição para a Câmara em 2026
item.description: Out of 513 federal deputies, 438 intend to run for reelection to the Chamber of Deputies in October 2026, according to a Diap survey based on TSE records. The PL and PT parties lead the ranking with 77 and 57 candidates seeking reelection, respectively, followed by União Brasil with 49. The first round of elections is scheduled for October 4th, with the second, if necessary, on October 25th.

item.title: Lula e Flávio fazem guerra de preços de comida nas redes sociais
item.description: The Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) campaigns are clashing on social media over basic food prices, using videos and posts to criticize or counter inflation narratives. The battle centers on economic issues, with both sides selectively highlighting data to attack each other.
